entries.reason: A left generator bound does not directly bound a right quotient. The dual bridge compares these particular left and right modules: simple modules on either side of $M_n lr((D))$ have the same residue-field dimension. Applying the full left-ideal hypothesis to every overorder completes the Bass conclusion.
